title: Intuit buys AI revenue startup Sequence to chase mid-market ERP customers
key_facts: Intuit announced on 15 Oct 2026 an agreement to acquire Sequence, an AI-powered revenue management startup; financial terms not disclosed
Sequence automates quote-to-revenue: pricing, contracts, invoicing, collections and revenue recognition; its AI agents take over routine finance tasks
The deal adds to QuickBooks Online Advanced and Intuit Enterprise Suite to win mid-market customers
Sequence co-founder and CEO Riya Grover called revenue management the most fragmented back-office workflow
Intuit shares rose more than 4% when written; Yahoo Finance had them up about 6% and roughly 50% below the start of the year
Intuit Global Business Solutions revenue rose 16% to $12.9 billion in fiscal 2026
quote_evidence: Intuit (INTU) is expanding its artificial intelligence (AI) capabilities with a deal to acquire Sequence, a startup that automates billing, contracts and revenue recognition for businesses.
Revenue management has long been the most fragmented workflow in the back office, said Sequence Co-Founder and CEO Riya Grover.
why_it_matters_hint: Gives mid-sized firms an AI billing and revenue tool inside software they already use.
